You gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks when using these skills against psionic outsiders with the air subtype. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures.|SlayerFavoredEnemy|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullAbility
